biography.plain_text: Tim Roberts is an Australian billionaire investor and managing director of Warburton Group, the Perth family office he developed after the sale of Multiplex. A son of Multiplex founder John Roberts, he inherited a stake in the construction group and has since invested across property, infrastructure, aviation, listed companies and private markets.

long_biography.plain_text:
Warburton Group has become Tim Roberts’s principal vehicle for private investment. Based in Perth, the family office allocates capital across listed equities, property, infrastructure, aviation, fishing and aquaculture. Roberts also served as an executive director of Multiplex before the family sold the construction group to Brookfield Asset Management.

Aviation developed into a substantial operating interest through AvWest, which financed and distributed Bombardier business aircraft. Roberts has also held a non-executive directorship at Mineral Resources and supported Western Australian cultural and medical organisations. These activities place investment management, rather than day-to-day construction, at the centre of his work after Multiplex.
